title: NowSwap — Dutch Auction batch() Reentrancy Vulnerability Analysis
loss_raw: Unconfirmed — no on-chain attack tx found
root_cause: When the batch() function makes multiple calls to the same function (commitEth), state is not updated between each call, allowing duplicate participation
attack_tx: No confirmed on-chain attack tx — simulation PoC demonstrating Dutch Auction batch() reentrancy; the major NowSwap loss ($1M+) was from a separate K-invariant bug in block 13,229,001 (fork block: 13,038,771)
steps: Step 1: Encode multiple commitEth call data
→ commitEth executes N times, same ETH applied per call
Step 3: Acquire participation rights counted as N×100 ETH
